text: Milk Academy, founded in 2006 and producing at its plants in Bursa, joined Cabir Holding in 2023, according to Türk Spor Ajansı.
short: Milk Academy has been part of Cabir Holding since 2023.

source.name: Türk Spor Ajansı: Fenerbahçe Beko’ya İki Yeni Sponsor
source.quote: 2023 yılında Cabir Holding bünyesine katılan Milk Academy
